Date pickers 📅 for the library

Had a great conversation with Andrew at the wf conf in London. He told me he spent a tremendous amount of his time building forms that included variously complex date pickers. + he told me he kinda assembled a private collection of them. . I'm definitely excited about the prospect of getting great, pre built form components and putting them on the library and I have open ears 👂 for anyone who might wanna contribute to making the StudioForm Pro Library include more relevant ui components in the future. All with the goal 🎯 of turning StudioForm (which is very capable but can be rather complex and effort intens at times) into a more enjoyable resource for low-code, no-code developers (& designers & end-clients).
